entries.name: Sunlit Maw

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (might) against a sunwoven/almanac rarity's own 4-5 affix count band. Everything else the muzzle does is the on-hit rider, which is generous precisely because the stat sheet does not see it.

entries.flavor: Every seed it fires follows the same taught arc the last one did — not because the aim is perfect, but because the lesson was.
entries.notes: element:light matches the theme's own affinity rather than an arbitrary pick. powerBand held to high/extreme on both fixed lines to sit inside rarity.ladder ordinal 90's tierWindow (4-5) — the exemplar's cultivated entry (tierWindow 1-3) used medium/low for the identical reason, scaled up.

entries.name: Trunk of the Lineage

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (fortitude). The recurring heal is a resource.delta rider the affix pool cannot roll on this role at this size, which is the entire point of the fixed core.

entries.flavor: Each ring records a season someone else survived first, and the trunk has not forgotten a single one of them.
entries.notes: Noun 'trunk' and concept 'lineage' both drawn from this partition's own theme pools (nounPools['core-guard.plant'], conceptPools['sunwoven-almanac']); neither word appears in the sets/charms files already authored against this theme.

entries.name: Copied Carapace

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (resilience). The on-damage-taken shield stack is the rider a ward-array's affix pool at this rung could not offer on top of a normal roll.

entries.flavor: The original shell cracked centuries ago. This one was copied down to the seam, and the seam has never once needed testing.
entries.notes: Deliberately avoids atom.carapace and atom.plating despite the name: both write arm1Max/arm2Max, Unity fields that exist only on humanoid/hybrid frames (frames: ["humanoid","hybrid"] on both, checked against g-armour.json) — the exact trap the unique exemplar's own notes call out. resilience/warding/sust-callus all carry frames ["humanoid","plant"] and are the plant-legal equivalents.

entries.name: Thicket of the Litany

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (quickening). The on-spawn shield is a rider, not a stat, and reads generous only because the sheet cannot price it.

entries.flavor: It recites the same warning to every hand that reaches in, and the warning has never once needed updating.
entries.notes: element:light again ties to the theme's own elementAffinity. 'litany' drawn from conceptPools['sunwoven-almanac'], not yet used by the sets or charms files already authored against this theme.

entries.name: Goldenmargin

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (vitality). Both economy families (midas, econ-bounty) sit in bands.v1.json's familiesOutOfFourWaySplit note, not the primaryChannel raw-stat group, so this jewel still carries only a single stat-sheet line.

entries.flavor: A scribe once noted, in gold ink, that this bloom pays for itself — and every gardener since has believed the margin note over the flower.
entries.notes: Name is a whole word from uniqueSetSeedPools['sunwoven-almanac'] (pattern 'fusion', pre-composed, used as-is rather than re-decomposed per naming.v1.json's rule 2a). Not yet used by sets.sunwoven-almanac.json or the charm files already authored against this theme (they used firstedition and copyhand from the same pool).

entries.name: Rehearsed Frond

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (savagery). The on-hit leech is the resource.delta rider; the sheet only ever sees the attack line.

entries.flavor: It has practiced the same cut ten thousand times and improved on none of them, because none of them ever needed improving.
entries.notes: Adjective 'rehearsed' from themeAdjectivePools['sunwoven-almanac'], not used elsewhere in this theme's already-authored sets/charms files.

entries.name: Arbour of the Canon

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (bulwark). The recurring heal is the rider; bulwark is the item's only line an ordinary stat sheet would ever show.

entries.flavor: Grown to the letter of a design nobody living wrote, the arbour holds the shape it was told to hold and asks no questions about who told it.
entries.notes: Concept 'canon' from conceptPools['sunwoven-almanac'], unused elsewhere in this theme's committed sets/charms content. 'Arbour' names the physical shape of a mantle piece (nounPools['mantle.plant']) — a covering garment, not a claim that the whole theme is a place, which the theme's own avoid-list reserves for hollow-orchard.

entries.name: Pagelight

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (warding). The status-resist rider is a status-channel family, not a primaryChannel stat, so it is generous for the same reason every other rider in this file is.

entries.flavor: Read enough pages back to back and the crown starts glowing on its own — not with an idea, only with everything that was ever written down.
entries.notes: Name is a whole word from uniqueSetSeedPools['sunwoven-almanac'], unused elsewhere in this theme's authored content. Kept arcane/no-origin-tag rather than organic/rooted since the flavor treats it as a woven artifact of pages, not living tissue.
